diagnostics.message: "welcome_credit_coupon_code" is not an environment-variable name (expected UPPER_SNAKE_CASE). keyFrom names the variable the reference's key is read from at reconciliation time; the catalog never holds the key itself (CLAUDE.md rule 3 — config comes from process.env), so a misspelled variable name is a reference nothing can ever resolve.
